verdict.rationale: Bolna produces AI-generated output from call data inside the product. It offers LLM-driven call summaries, an agent-level toggle that is off by default, and extraction categories that pair a name with a model to pull structured data from calls; both are configured in the Analytics tab alongside call-history metrics and transcripts. However, this amounts to per-call summarization and extraction, not proactive insights or recommendations across your data. Missing for 10: AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, cross-call aggregate insights, hands-on or independent corroboration of summary and extraction quality.
